song.name: Haunting Life
song.plot: From her eternal exile, Anya, the last Nephilim, reflects on her 'haunting life'—her cursed fate as the eternal warden. Though her existence is now one of endless waiting in a world of shadows, her spirit endures as a 'haunting echo of hope.' In the realms above, Seraphina, now a queen forged in loss and inspired by Anya's sacrifice, begins to build a kingdom worthy of that sacrifice, her new core motivation set in stone.
song.analysis: The original song is about a "cursed fate" and "endless wait." This is a perfect fit for the epilogue. The adaptation makes minor but crucial changes to frame this as Anya's reflection from within her eternal prison. It's no longer just a "haunting life" but a sacrifice made willingly. The final question in the bridge is answered with the knowledge that her sacrifice gave Seraphina a reason for living and building.

verse.original: I live in a world of shadows Where nothing is what it seems I live in a world of pain Where happiness is just a dream
verse.adapted: I live in a world of shadows, A warden for all it seems. I live in a world of darkness, To protect all other dreams.

chorus.original: This is my haunting life This is my cursed fate This is my wasted time This is my endless wait
chorus.adapted: This is my haunting life, This is my chosen fate. This is not wasted time, This is my endless wait.

bridge.original: Is there a way out of this misery? Is there a hope for a better destiny? Is there a chance for a new beginning? Is there a reason for this living?
bridge.adapted: There is no way out of this prison, But there is hope for a better destiny. For Seraphina, a new beginning, She is the reason for my living.
